lines.zh: 我拍着鳍在空中游，眼睛不动。
lines.en: I swim the air on my fins, my eye never blinking.

lines.zh: 我这颗眼球一样的身体在水上漂。
lines.en: This eye-shaped body drifts above the water.
I fly toward the red forest.
I sweep over the lake surface.

lines.zh: 我的尾摆了一下，转了向。
lines.en: One tail stroke and I change heading.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面低飞，眼睛盯着。
lines.en: I fly low over the water with my eye fixed.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵绯红的树飞。
lines.en: I circle a crimson tree.
I drift along, my eye on you.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水面上很小。
lines.en: My shadow is small on the water.
I pass through a bank of mist.

lines.zh: 我从湖的这一边飘到那一边。
lines.en: I drift from one side of the lake to the other.

lines.zh: 我贴着绯红的树梢飞过去。
lines.en: I skim past the crimson treetops.

lines.zh: 我飞着，尾在后面慢慢摆。
lines.en: I fly with my tail swaying behind.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直朝着同一个方向。
lines.en: My eye stays fixed on one direction.
In the mist I see only outlines.
I turn half about and check behind.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，只让尾慢慢摆。
lines.en: I hold still and let my tail drift.
This eye never closes.
The mist in the crimson forest runs violet.

lines.zh: 我盯着一处水面，很久了。
lines.en: I have watched one patch of water a long while.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在空气里轻轻扇。
lines.en: My fins beat gently in the air.
A fish broke the surface.
I turn my body a little.

lines.zh: 水下有我的倒影，也在看我。
lines.en: My reflection in the water looks back.
I see a long way.

lines.zh: 这里的水是暗的，林子更暗。
lines.en: The water is dark here. The wood darker.

lines.zh: 我没有眼皮，也没法转开。
lines.en: I have no lids and cannot look away.
My fins pause, then beat again.
Something moved deep in the trees.
My eye is fixed on one point.
I see you. I keep seeing you.

lines.zh: 你走哪边，我这只眼就转哪边。
lines.en: Wherever you go, this eye follows.

lines.zh: 你不知道该看哪只眼吧。
lines.en: You are not sure which eye to meet.
I have only one, and it suffices.
Your shadow wavers in the water.

lines.zh: 我认得这种呼吸的节奏。
lines.en: I know the rhythm of that breathing.
You came from the crimson forest side.

lines.zh: 这颗眼睛不会眨眼，你会的。
lines.en: This eye cannot blink. Yours can.
I have stopped in front of you.

lines.zh: 你再看久一点，我就动了。
lines.en: Look a moment longer and I will move.
My body has been knocked askew.

lines.zh: 我退了半格，眼睛还看着。
lines.en: I give half a block, eye still fixed.
Water runs out of the wound.

lines.zh: 我悬不稳了，往下掉了一点。
lines.en: I lose my hover and drop a little.
That blow left a mark on my bone.
Slowly I right myself.

lines.zh: 我这一只眼，转得比身子快。
lines.en: This single eye turns faster than my body.

lines.zh: 红色在水里化开，我盯着
lines.en: Red blooms in the water; I keep watching.
I rise again and hold my eye on you.
It is not yet time to close.
Is that the smell of fish?
I descend toward the surface.
Too faint. I cannot catch it.
I snapped at it and got water.
Only what still moves will I bite.
Try putting it in the water.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点东西看了很久。
lines.en: I stared at that thing a long while.

lines.zh: 这点吃食，不够我动一次。
lines.en: That is not worth one movement.

lines.zh: 绕一圈，还是回到这片水里。
lines.en: One circuit, and back to this water.
I swallowed it and tasted nothing.
Your hand went through my shadow.
I drift back a block.
I am wet. Do not touch me.

lines.zh: 你撞了我，我连方向都没改。
lines.en: You hit me and I did not even change heading.
Stop swinging at the air.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶滑到你背后
lines.en: I slide over your head and behind you.
My fin brushed you.
At that touch I rose half a block.
You stepped on nothing but water.

lines.zh: 退开一截，我这只眼没移
lines.en: I withdraw a stretch, eye never leaving.

lines.zh: 水里还有几只这样的眼睛。
lines.en: There are other eyes like mine in the water.
Each of them watches its own way.
We do not gather.

lines.zh: 有一只在湖对岸，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw one across the lake.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛对望，谁也没动
lines.en: Two eyes meet; neither of us moves.
Then it drifted into the trees.
We need not come closer.

lines.zh: 这片水够我们各占一边。
lines.en: This water fits us on either side.
I remember the look of its eye.

lines.zh: 这算是我们说过的全部。
lines.en: That was the whole of our exchange.
I took what was floating there.
I caught a piece in my mouth.
Too hard. I spat it out.
I do not want this bright thing.
It sank, and so did I.

lines.zh: 水里捞出来的，都是我的。
lines.en: What comes out of the water is mine.
I push it away with a fin.
I cannot take what lies on the ground.
I held it a while and let it go.
That is worth nothing.

lines.zh: 泡在水里的脚，我看见了
lines.en: I see the feet wading in the shallows.
My eye is already on it.
It has not looked up. Good.
I come around from downwind.

lines.zh: 一个冲刺，水花扑到你脸上
lines.en: One dash and the spray hits your face.
It is stooping to scoop water.
An exposed neck is a weakness.
A tail stroke leaves a white line on the water.
The mist on the water will hide me.

lines.zh: 它还在捧水，我贴得更低
lines.en: It still scoops water; I drop lower.
I take half a circle around behind it.
It looks up; I am at the surface.
I drop until I brush the water.
Its shadow tells me where it is.
I stop and wait for it to turn.
Its back is to the lake.
When it turns its back, I dash.
I cut a line across the surface.
It heard and turned its head.
Too late. I am already here.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的河里，我睁着眼游。
lines.en: In the crimson river, I swim with eyes open.
My teeth take its shoulder.
It slaps me away.

lines.zh: 我又飘回来，咬它的手臂。
lines.en: I drift back in and bite its arm.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得它退到水里。
lines.en: That drives it back into the water.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的河里，我游得快。
lines.en: In the crimson river, I'm quick.
I press my whole body against it.
It holds me and I twist free.
My tail sweeps its face.
It drops to its knees in a wide splash.
I rise from beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 水珠顺着我的身体流下去。
lines.en: Water runs down my body.

lines.zh: 绯红林子的雾就在那边。
lines.en: The crimson forest mist is right over there.

lines.zh: 我这只眼睛先看了看四周。
lines.en: This eye checks all around first.
I hang one block above the lake.
The lake is still but for one ring.

lines.zh: 我把尾摆了一下，离了水。
lines.en: One tail stroke and I leave the water.
The grass at the water's edge is wet.
Out of the water, I shake my fins.
There is red light in the trees.
Fire touched me and I sank into the water.

lines.zh: 我失了高度，砸在水面上。
lines.en: I lost height and hit the surface.

lines.zh: 我被按下去，这只眼还睁着。
lines.en: Held under, this eye stays open.

lines.zh: 爆响把水掀起来，也掀起了我。
lines.en: The blast threw up water and me with it.

lines.zh: 一支箭朝着这只眼睛来。
lines.en: An arrow came for this eye.
Strange light froze my turn.
There are no fish left in this lake.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面，我全身一紧。
lines.en: Lightning hit the surface and my whole body clenched.
The water is gone and I am falling.
